title: Triple Coil Wrap Bangle
descriptionHtml:
Three turns, one line of gold. One continuous snake-coil wire, finely ribbed and about 4mm thick, wraps the wrist in three stacked turns. Each end finishes in a small rectangular cap set with two rows of clear pavé, one sitting on the top turn and one on the bottom. It looks like a stack, and goes on as one piece. In warm gold or bright silver tone.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone. It already looks like a stack of three.

Details

  • Construction: One continuous ribbed snake coil wire, approximately 4mm, wound in three turns
  • Height: Approximately 14mm across the three turns
  • Ends: Two small rectangular caps set with clear pavé, on the top and bottom turns
  • Fit: Flexible wrap that eases over the hand
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated or rhodium plated silver tone (choose above)
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
